items.source: the request matcher
items.translation: 请求匹配器

items.source: name - the name of the query parameter whose value(s) will be asserted
items.translation: name - 将被断言其值（或值）的查询参数的名称

items.source: name - the name of the header whose value(s) will be asserted
items.translation: name - 将被断言其值（或值）的标头名称

items.source: See headerList(String, Matcher) for a variant which accepts a Hamcrest Matcher that applies to the entire list of values as opposed to applying only to individual values.
items.translation: 参见headerList(String, Matcher)，该变体接受一个适用于整个值列表的 Hamcrest Matcher，而不是仅适用于单个值。

items.source: Variant of requestTo(URI) that prepares the URI from a URI template plus optional variables via UriComponentsBuilder including encoding.
items.translation: `requestTo(URI)` 的变体，通过 `UriComponentsBuilder` 从 URI 模板和可选变量准备 URI（包括编码）。

items.source: expression - the XPath optionally parameterized with arguments
items.translation: expression - 可选带参数的 XPath

items.source: args - arguments to parameterize the XPath expression with
items.translation: args - 用于参数化 XPath 表达式的参数

items.source: For example, this can be used to check that the list of query parameter values has at least one value matching a given Hamcrest matcher (such as Matchers.hasItem(Matcher)), that every value in the list matches common criteria (such as Matchers.everyItem(Matcher)), that each value in the list matches corresponding dedicated criteria (such as Matchers.contains(Matcher[])), etc.
items.translation: 例如，这可用于检查查询参数值列表中是否至少有一个值匹配给定的 Hamcrest 匹配器（如Matchers.hasItem(Matcher)），列表中每个值是否都符合通用标准（如Matchers.everyItem(Matcher)），列表中每个值是否都符合对应的专用标准（如Matchers.contains(Matcher[])）等。

items.source: For example, this can be used to check that the list of header values has at least one value matching a given Hamcrest matcher (such as Matchers.hasItem(Matcher)), that every value in the list matches common criteria (such as Matchers.everyItem(Matcher)), that each value in the list matches corresponding dedicated criteria (such as Matchers.contains(Matcher[])), etc.
items.translation: 例如，这可用于检查标题值列表中是否至少有一个值匹配给定的 Hamcrest 匹配器（如Matchers.hasItem(Matcher)），列表中每个值是否都符合通用标准（如Matchers.everyItem(Matcher)），列表中每个值是否都符合对应的专用标准（如Matchers.contains(Matcher[])）等。

items.source: If the query parameter value list is larger than the number of provided matchers, no matchers will be applied to the extra query parameter values, effectively ignoring the additional parameter values. If the number of provided matchers exceeds the number of query parameter values, an AssertionError will be thrown to signal the mismatch.
items.translation: 如果查询参数值列表大于提供的matchers数量，则不会将任何匹配器应用于额外的查询参数值，从而实际上忽略了这些附加的参数值。如果提供的matchers数量超过查询参数值的数量，将抛出AssertionError以指示不匹配。

items.source: If the query parameter value list is larger than the number of expectedValues, no assertions will be applied to the extra query parameter values, effectively ignoring the additional parameter values. If the number of expectedValues exceeds the number of query parameter values, an AssertionError will be thrown to signal the mismatch.
items.translation: 如果查询参数值列表的数量大于expectedValues的数量，则不会对额外的查询参数值应用任何断言，从而实际上忽略了这些附加的参数值。如果expectedValues的数量超过查询参数值的数量，将抛出AssertionError以指示不匹配。

items.source: If the header value list is larger than the number of provided matchers, no matchers will be applied to the extra header values, effectively ignoring the additional header values. If the number of provided matchers exceeds the number of header values, an AssertionError will be thrown to signal the mismatch.
items.translation: 如果标头值列表大于提供的matchers数量，则不会对额外的标头值应用任何匹配器，从而实际上忽略了这些额外的标头值。如果提供的matchers数量超过标头值的数量，将抛出AssertionError以指示不匹配。

items.source: If the header value list is larger than the number of expectedValues, no matchers will be applied to the extra header values, effectively ignoring the additional header values. If the number of expectedValues exceeds the number of header values, an AssertionError will be thrown to signal the mismatch.
items.translation: 如果标头值列表大于 `expectedValues` 的数量，则不会将任何匹配器应用于额外的标头值，从而实际上忽略了这些额外的标头值。如果 `expectedValues` 的数量超过标头值的数量，将抛出 AssertionError 以指示不匹配。

items.source: See queryParamList(String, Matcher) for a variant which accepts a Matcher that applies to the entire list of values as opposed to applying only to individual values.
items.translation: 参见 queryParamList(String, Matcher)，这是一个接受一个适用于整个值列表的Matcher 的变体，而不是仅应用于各个值。

items.source: See queryParamList(String, Matcher) for a variant which accepts a Hamcrest Matcher that applies to the entire list of values as opposed to asserting only individual values.
items.translation: 参见queryParamList(String, Matcher)，该变体接受一个适用于整个值列表的 Hamcrest Matcher，而不是仅断言单个值。

items.source: Access to request body matchers using a JsonPath expression to inspect a specific subset of the body. The JSON path expression can be a parameterized string using formatting specifiers as defined in String.format(String, Object...).
items.translation: 使用 JsonPath 表达式访问请求体匹配器以检查特定子集。JSON 路径表达式可以是使用 String.format(String, Object...) 中定义的格式说明符进行参数化的字符串。

items.source: Assert the HttpMethod of the request.
items.translation: 断言请求的HttpMethod。

items.source: Access to request body matchers using an XPath to inspect a specific subset of the body. The XPath expression can be a parameterized string using formatting specifiers as defined in String.format(String, Object...).
items.translation: 使用 XPath 访问请求体匹配器以检查特定子集。XPath 表达式可以是使用 String.format(String, Object...) 中定义的格式说明符进行参数化的字符串。

items.source: Access to response body matchers using an XPath to inspect a specific subset of the body. The XPath expression can be a parameterized string using formatting specifiers as defined in String.format(String, Object...).
items.translation: 使用 XPath 访问响应体匹配器以检查特定子集。XPath 表达式可以是使用String.format(String, Object...)中定义的格式说明符进行参数化的字符串。

items.source: Access to request body matchers using a JsonPath expression to inspect a specific subset of the body and a Hamcrest match for asserting the value found at the JSON path.
items.translation: 使用 JsonPath 表达式访问请求体匹配器以检查特定子集，并使用 Hamcrest 匹配断言在 JSON 路径处找到的值。

items.source: Match to any request.
items.translation: 匹配任何请求。

items.source: Access to request body matchers.
items.translation: 访问请求体匹配器。

items.source: Assert that the given request header does not exist.
items.translation: 断言给定的请求头不存在。

items.source: Assert the number of query parameters present in the request.
items.translation: 断言请求中存在的查询参数数量。

items.source: Assert the request URI matches the given string.
items.translation: 断言请求 URI 与给定字符串匹配。

items.source: Expect a request to the given URI.
items.translation: 期望收到对给定 URI 的请求。

items.source: Assert the request URI string with the given Hamcrest matcher.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Hamcrest 匹配器断言请求 URI 字符串。

items.source: matchers - the Hamcrest matchers to apply to individual query parameter values; the nth matcher is applied to the nth query parameter value
items.translation: `matchers` - 要应用于各个查询参数值的 Hamcrest 匹配器；第 n 个匹配器应用于第 n 个查询参数值。

items.source: expectedValues - the expected values of individual query parameter values; the nth expected value is compared to the nth query parameter value
items.translation: `expectedValues` - 各个查询参数值的预期值；第 n 个预期值与第 n 个查询参数值进行比较。

items.source: matchers - the Hamcrest matchers to apply to individual header values; the nth matcher is applied to the nth header value
items.translation: `matchers` - 要应用于各个标头值的 Hamcrest 匹配器；第 n 个匹配器应用于第 n 个标头值。

items.source: expectedValues - the expected values of individual header values; the nth expected value is compared to the nth header value
items.translation: `expectedValues` - 各个标头值的预期值；第 n 个预期值与第 n 个标头值进行比较。

items.source: method - the HTTP method
items.translation: method - HTTP 方法

items.source: matcher - the String matcher for the expected URI
items.translation: matcher - 预期 URI 的字符串匹配器

items.source: expectedUri - the expected URI
items.translation: expectedUri - 预期的 URI

items.source: expectedUri - the expected URI template
items.translation: expectedUri - 预期的 URI 模板

items.source: uriVars - zero or more URI variables to populate the expected URI
items.translation: uriVars - 零个或多个用于填充预期 URI 的 URI 变量

items.source: uri - the expected URI
items.translation: uri - 预期的 URI

items.source: matcher - the Hamcrest matcher to apply to the entire list of values for the given query parameter
items.translation: matcher - 用于给定查询参数的整个值列表的 Hamcrest 匹配器

items.source: expectedCount - the number of expected query parameters
items.translation: expectedCount - 预期查询参数的数量

items.source: matcher - the Hamcrest matcher to apply to the entire list of values for the given header
items.translation: matcher - 要应用于给定标头的所有值列表的 Hamcrest 匹配器

items.source: expression - the JSON path optionally parameterized with arguments
items.translation: expression - 可选地带有参数的 JSON 路径

items.source: args - arguments to parameterize the JSON path expression with
items.translation: args - 用于参数化 JSON 路径表达式的参数

items.source: expression - the JSON path expression
items.translation: expression - JSON 路径表达式

items.source: matcher - a matcher for the value expected at the JSON path
items.translation: matcher - 用于匹配 JSON 路径预期值的匹配器

items.source: namespaces - the namespaces referenced in the XPath expression
items.translation: namespaces - XPath 表达式中引用的命名空间
